description_en: Starts an instance refresh task in a scaling group to apply a new scaling configuration or update the image of instances in the scaling group
description_zh: 在您需要将新的伸缩配置应用到伸缩组实例中时，或需要更新伸缩组中实例的镜像时，您可以调用本接口完成伸缩组中实例的刷新

parameters.help_en:
The desired configuration for the instance refresh.

> - You cannot specify ScalingConfigurationId, ImageId, LaunchTemplateId, and Containers at the same time. You must specify one of them.
- The refresh task skips instances in the scaling group that already match the desired configuration
parameters.help_zh:
实例刷新的期望配置。

> - ScalingConfigurationId 、ImageId、LaunchTemplateId、Containers 不可以同时设置，且必须要设置一个。
- 刷新任务会跳过伸缩组中与期望配置匹配的实例
parameters.name: desired_configuration

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to skip instances that match the desired configuration.

> The system determines whether an instance matches based on the ID of the desired scaling configuration, not by comparing specific configuration items.

Valid values:

- true: Instances that were already created with the desired configuration are skipped.
- false: All instances in the scaling group are refreshed when the instance refresh task starts.

Default value: true.
parameters.description_zh:
是否跳过和期望配置匹配的实例。

> 系统会根据期望伸缩配置的 ID 界定是否匹配，不会对比具体的配置项。

取值范围：

- true：跳过。当启动实例刷新任务时，系统会检查每个实例的配置。对于已经使用期望配置创建的实例，不执行刷新操作。
- false：不跳过。在启动实例刷新任务后，刷新任务启动时所有伸缩组中的实例。

默认值：true。

parameters.description_en:
The execution strategy for the instance refresh task. Valid values:

* Rolling: refreshes instances by creating new instances and releasing old instances.
* ReplaceSystemDisk: updates the system cloud disk of existing instances by specifying DesiredConfiguration.image.

Default value: Rolling.
parameters.description_zh:
实例刷新任务的运行策略，取值范围：

* Rolling：实例刷新任务通过创建新实例，释放旧实例的方式进行实例刷新。
* ReplaceSystemDisk：在原有实例基础上更新系统盘，通过指定 DesiredConfiguration.image 更新实例系统盘。

默认值：Rolling。
